{{Quote|Less than forty meters from the path, I saw the Tree. I have thought of it ever since as a proper noun&mdash;it wasn't just a tree like so many others in the jungle. It was the Tree, and it had stood in the jungle for centuries before sending out its signal and drawing me in. The signal, which I first took for a simple odor, turned out to be much more.|Besaama, on the Tree|<ref name="Making of a Witch" />}}
The '''Tree''' was a large [[Tree/Legends|tree]] situated in the [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] that was inhabited by members of the [[Wyrd]], a group of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] [[Tarasin]] [[The Force/Legends|Force]] [[Witch/Legends|witches]]. The Tree contained a concealed door at its base and within there was a twisting staircase carved into the wood leading to various chambers sited all the way up to the the treetop. At some stage during the last [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the Tarasin [[Besaama]] was drawn to the Tree and went inside, leaving two [[Standard day/Legends|days]] later as a member of the Wyrd. Besaama later left the Wyrd and gave an account of how she has came to be lured to the Tree.<ref name="Making of a Witch" />
